hypotheses.H1: Fixed-parameter iterative readers combine retained relationships when permitted sufficient stages; state removal and insufficient depth should reduce supported answers.
hypotheses.H2: Ordinary continuation and task-adapted attention can be judged against fixed core/direct/durability criteria; no candidate is required to pass for an otherwise complete experiment.
hypotheses.H3: Close-identity preparation may trade supported retrieval against missing-information performance. Report the tradeoff and every seed; no historical outcome is a target.
hypotheses.H4: Whole-map degradation can occur without a queried answer failure. Count source/map/operation invariants separately from answer accuracy.

resume_contract.evaluation: cell-atomic commits including all durability prefixes; deterministic replay of failed partial cell under a new retained attempt; previous completed cells hash-verified and not rerun

resume_contract.training: joint optimizer/parameters/RNG/stream/trace checkpoint every1000 updates, cooperative stop saves earlier if safe; new output attempt only

retention.development: all current reports, checkpoints and partial/failure evidence retained
retention.failed_or_partial: retain every actual partial checkpoint and failure receipt
retention.successful_main: final full optimizer/stream/RNG checkpoint with complete trace retained losslessly, plus independent manifest and logs; intermediate successful checkpoints may be removed only after final reload and hash checks and recorded in retention ledger

stop_rules: Stop a fit on nonfinite loss/gradient/state, source identity drift, unexpected data/seed/checkpoint binding, or measured resource ceiling. Preserve failure and last joint checkpoint.
No silent restarts, seed exclusions, fewer updates, omitted conditions, or replacing new weights with pilot weights. Any repaired rerun uses a new attempt ID and retains the failed attempt.
A complete negative scientific result is allowed; failed coverage/scoring/verifier or missing checkpoints prevent complete-study status.
Do not change numerical thresholds based on heldout outcomes. Development corrections and deviations have dated source diffs.
teacher_forcing: updates1..1000 plus every fourth one-based update thereafter

verification_retraining.compare: Exact final tensors, optimizer arrays, per-update losses/gradients/input digests/RNG; wall times and attempt identifiers excluded from numerical equality, raw files retained.
